verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers financial-account creation, fund movement, transactions, and fraud controls, but nowhere describes a rules engine or event-triggered automation (e.g., 'if X happens, do Y automatically') configurable by users; automatic risk controls are pre-set by Stripe, not user-defined rules. Missing for 10: any documentation of user-defined conditional rules/triggers, an automation/rules API or webhook-based rule builder, or evidence of event-driven action configuration.
